description: This file implements the rx::TextureStorage9 class and its derived classes for handling D3D9 textures, including 2D textures, cube textures, and EGLImage-based textures, with functions for managing texture data, render targets, mipmaps, and copying between textures.

classes.name: TextureStorage9
classes.description: Abstract base class for D3D9 texture storage handling, providing interface for texture data management and properties.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_2D
classes.description: Handles 2D texture storage in D3D9, including creation, surface access, mipmap generation, and copying.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_Cube
classes.description: Handles cube map texture storage in D3D9, including creation, surface access per face, mipmap generation, and copying.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_EGLImage
classes.description: Handles EGLImage-based texture storage in D3D9, providing access to surfaces and textures from EGLImages.

methods.name: GetTextureUsage
methods.description: Determines D3D usage flags based on internal format and render target status.

methods.name: isRenderTarget
methods.description: Checks if the texture storage is configured as a render target.

methods.name: isManaged
methods.description: Checks if the texture pool is managed.

methods.name: supportsNativeMipmapFunction
methods.description: Indicates if native mipmap functions are supported (returns false).

methods.name: getSurfaceLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the surface level for a 2D or cube texture at a specified mip level.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Gets or creates a render target for a specific texture level or face.

methods.name: generateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps by filtering from a source level to a destination level.

methods.name: getBaseTexture
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the underlying D3D texture object.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies texture data from this storage to another TextureStorage.
